## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5). Confirmation: widespread 1W sector gains but large-cap tech and several majors show 1M weakness and RECOVERY/BELOW TREND divergences, supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) showing clear strength. Materials strong: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%); Consumer Staples resilient: MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials lag: LMT CORRECTION (1W: -3.73% | 1M: +7.85%) and DE CORRECTION (1W: -6.43% | 1M: +19.31%). Technology shows mixed weakness at large caps: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) and several tech names BELOW TREND or RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%), NFLX RECOVERY (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), PYPL RECOVERY (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%), CRM RECOVERY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%). Leadership: Broad (5 sectors); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -2.05%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -3.33%), LMT CORRECTION (1W: -3.73% | 1M: +7.85%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.06%). Weakness concentrated in Technology and Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: CEG (1W: +10.94%), NFLX (1W: +9.86%), FCX (1W: +9.29%), PYPL (1W: +9.11%), CRM (1W: +7.65%). Note major divergence: multiple large caps showing 1W vs 1M mismatch (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, CRM etc.) — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE; watch for trend breaks and treat as tactical, not broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is mixed with signs of distribution: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%). Sector 1W positive but 1M weakness persists (Technology: 24 stocks), monitor for confirmation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are up modestly this week but internally mixed: PYPL RECOVERY (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.62% | 1M: +1.94%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -2.43%). Breadth 1W positive but 1M near-flat; style tilt unclear.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows mild strength with mixed signals: PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.26%), JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -1.52%). Sector 1W positive and 1M modestly positive, defensive names showing some leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Utilities and Materials leaders (CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%)) and reduce exposure to lagging large-cap techs showing BELOW TREND (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%)). Monitor RECOVERY names (NFLX RECOVERY (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%), CRM RECOVERY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%)) for follow-through before increasing exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%). BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%), IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -17.17%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +8.55%; 10 stocks) and Materials (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +6.37%; 11 stocks) given leadership. BEARISH: Industrials (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.76%; 15 stocks) and Technology (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -8.16%; 24 stocks) for 1M weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA: sustained failure to reclaim recent 1M highs keeps it BELOW TREND and at risk of further downside. AAPL holding ABOVE TREND on 1W strength would signal rotation into select growth; FCX/CEG sustaining ABOVE TREND would confirm cyclicals rotation. Monitor MSFT RECOVERY to see if 1M weakness resolves before treating strength as durable.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
FCX (+65): Freeport headline aligns with price — FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) — sentiment confirmed. MNST (+55): Q4 beat aligns with MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) — sentiment confirmed. ACN (+55): partnership headline but ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) — sentiment diverging from price, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-50): fund exit and softer guidance coincide with UNH CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +1.40%) — sentiment confirming near-term risk. HD (-50): negative retail commentary and HD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -1.39%) — confirming consumer risk. F (-55): recall headline yet F ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +4.57%) — sentiment diverges, monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%)) and mixed news signals (ACN bullish but BELOW TREND) — watch for confirmation.
